entries.zh: 衬里；衣服的里子（缝在衣内的一层）
entries.en: lining (of a garment); the inner side of clothing
inside; interior; the inner lining side

entries.zh: 侮辱；欺凌（agraviar 即侵害、欺负）
entries.en: to affront, to insult; to wrong, to aggrieve
entries.notes: L 栏「q[ue]」系缩写展开，词义另由 H「辱」与 M/R 互证。

entries.en: to shame, to disgrace; to make ashamed

entries.zh: 阻辱；当众折辱、使人受挫蒙羞
entries.en: to put to shame openly; to check and humiliate
entries.notes: 「阻辱」非常见词，依 M/R 的 chó 读音及西语 afrentar, correr（当众羞辱）定为折辱义。

entries.en: to insult; to humiliate; to bully
entries.notes: H 栏作「凄」，而 M/R 皆作 lēng，当为「凌辱」。

entries.en: to bully and insult; to abuse

entries.zh: 狼狈；落魄难堪（原富今贫者与贱者为伍的窘态）
entries.en: to be in a sorry plight; to fall in with the base (of one once rich, now poor)
entries.notes: 西语 agavillarse con los ruines 指与贱者为伍，汉栏取「狼狈」状其落魄。

entries.zh: 鹰；鹞鹰（猛禽，águila 之对译）
entries.notes: H 栏作「鳶」而 M/R 皆作 ěng（鹰），所指为鹰类猛禽。

entries.en: yellow hawk; a kind of eagle
entries.notes: 依 M/R（ěng n̂g／ěng hoâng）当读作「鹰黄」，即黄鹰。

entries.zh: 且；那么、就（用于「如今尽可……」的语气）
entries.en: well then; just (as in 'now you may ...')
entries.notes: 「且」作语气词对译 agora bien puedes，语义由上下文推得。

entries.zh: 且去；暂且去吧（如今你可走了）
entries.en: you may go now; just go (for now)
